scope: Stabilize the exact Windows package UI test's entry of the AgentMemory port in Signal Settings.

prior_exact_package.head: 5db24274cfcd893418ded866d210e44d02cc5c93
prior_exact_package.result: The Windows package test read only `7` from the field instead of `7333` before Save. The macOS package passed; the Windows artifact is not accepted as verified.

red.result: Failed against the old bulk-send driver because it had no per-character UI state synchronization.

change: The test driver selects the current text once, sends one digit, and waits for ValuePattern to equal the expected prefix before it sends the next digit. Exact-package run 40608159958 confirmed schedule persistence but exposed that PowerShell does not resolve the [ushort] alias used for each character. A source-contract regression now rejects [ushort] and requires [System.UInt16]; the driver uses that framework-qualified cast. The existing durable signal-transport.json assertion remains the success oracle.

local_verification.regression_red: The updated dispatch contract failed before the cast fix because the source still contained [ushort].

exact_windows_package_rerun.result: Schedule journey passed. Signal-settings UI automation failed before input because PowerShell could not find type [ushort]. The package artifact was retained; this is a test-driver failure, not evidence of settings persistence.

latest_exact_package_revalidation.head: eed32151780007af5e0e30e714b0962e75247de8
latest_exact_package_revalidation.result: Windows briefing, desktop, and schedule passed. Signal settings failed before Save while entering the port: PORT_CHARACTER_NOT_APPLIED expected=73 actual=7. Tool-decision was not reached.
latest_exact_package_revalidation.diagnosis: The test reused the UIA edit element captured before text input while the application may recreate that element after state updates. This is a test-driver stale-element hypothesis until the corrected package confirms it.
latest_exact_package_revalidation.fix: The character-observation poll now reacquires the visible agentmemory port edit element before every ValuePattern read.
latest_exact_package_revalidation.red_green: signal_port_reacquires_the_edit_control_after_each_keypress failed before the reacquisition was added and passes afterward.
latest_exact_package_revalidation.local_verification: signal-settings dispatch and source-layout suites pass 13 combined; warning-denied all-target Clippy, rustfmt, git diff --check, and the 300-line guard pass.

acceptance: No workflow credit; candidate package acceptance remains 22/25 until the exact Windows tool-decision workflow also passes.
